title: PCL Holding
description: PCL Holding Public Company Limited is a Thai-based holding entity operating as a premier importer and distributor of diagnostic instruments, reagents, and consumables for medical and research laboratories. The company manages a comprehensive portfolio of products across hematology, chemistry, immunology, and laboratory automation systems, representing globally recognized brands such as Beckman Coulter. With over 100 employees, the organization serves a broad client base of hospitals and government sectors throughout the Thai domestic market. Established in 1995 and converted to a public company in 2023, the firm delivers end-to-end service support to the public health sector. The company’s structure as a holding company enables strategic management of its diverse operational subsidiaries and product verticals to drive market leadership.
